baselineStrategy: Git blobs preserve clean tracked output bytes; only pre-existing modified output files are copied. At final source freeze take a new immutable baseline. Copy changed/new test outputs to full-regression/changed-outputs, then restore historical output bytes from baseline only. Do not alter sources, assets, test sources, or existing boss evidence.
knownLimit: Inventory labels are historical leads, not proof that current failures predate the patch; classify as unverified until controlled evidence supports attribution.
